_schema: Per-stage deliverable requirements. Read by skills/verifier.md to know what to check.
_note: Verifier reads this file and runs each stage's checks against fresh evidence.

worker.description: Code implementation task — any task dispatched to a Worker subagent.

required_state_updates.check: completed task array contains this task id
required_state_updates.enforcement: block — task must be marked completed before handoff

required_state_updates.check: TASK_COMPLETED event appended with matching task id

required_build_checks.expect: exit 1 (grep exits 1 when no matches found — any match means a stub was left in)
required_build_checks.note: Replace <files_owned> with the space-separated list of files from the task's scope field.

conditional_checks.when: task scope includes server.ts, GameLoop.ts, run-full-game.js, or dashboard/src/
conditional_checks.description: Live server endpoint check — verifies browser would actually load

reconciler.description: Build fix task — run after sprint with failing build.

required_state_updates.check: grade is not null, last_run is a recent timestamp

evaluator.description: Evaluation run — three phases, writes grade to build-health.json.

required_state_updates.check: grade is A, B, C, D, or F (not null); last_run is recent; history array has new entry

planner.description: Sprint planning — emits tasks to state/tasks.json.

required_state_updates.check: tasks array contains at least 3 items with id, description, priority, and status fields
